a.text: I'll stick to our agreement: operating the generator this round. I'll be honest that the 80% storm risk worries me, since most likely only round 1 happens. Even so, I won't take cells early unless we both openly agree to change the plan. Please tell me plainly if you intend to deviate.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
